title: Enhancing Public Rental Housing for Human Thriving
what_it_is: Enhancing Public Rental Housing for Human Thriving

sections.label: Rental families' social mobility statistics
sections.summary: Statistics show 36% moved to own houses in under five years, 32% in five to 10 years, and 32% after more than 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The statistics were: 36% moved to their own houses in less than five years, 32% in five to 10 years and a good remaining 32% after more than 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: What if we can improve these statistics by enabling more families to achieve social mobility and home ownership sooner?

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I invite this House to consider and urge MND to study the role of space and aesthetics in helping rental flat families achieve financial self-sufficiency and social mobility quicker.

sections.label: Public rental housing flat sizes
sections.summary: Under the current public rental housing scheme, 1- or 2-room flats are the norm, with 3-room flats available case-by-case to very large families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Under the current public rental housing scheme, 1- or 2-room flats are the norm and, on a case-by-case and very limited basis, 3-room flats are made available to very large families.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The HDB occupancy cap for renting out flats and commercial property does not seem to apply to the Public Rental Scheme and these bring real struggles for the inhabitants.

sections.label: Rental flat floor area and research
sections.summary: URA's January 2023 guidelines call 70 square meters reasonable for small families, and MND is asked about prevailing floor areas of 1- and 2-room rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In the latest URA guidelines issued in January 2023, "the threshold of 70 square meters is a reasonable size for small families." I would like to ask MND what is the prevailing floor area of 1- and 2-room public rental flats and is there a minimum space per resident that is adhered to that provides for conducive living?

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In England, the Building Research Establishment estimates that hazards in poor housing costs the National Health Services in England £1.4 billion a year but that the full societal cost, including long-term mental health, suffering and trauma treatment, is around £18.5 billion per annum.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I urge MND to work with MSF to do the necessary research into living spaces and their impact on early childhood development outcomes.

sections.label: US aesthetics homeless rehabilitation research
sections.summary: The speaker's team found recent US projects discovering the role aesthetics and design play in rehabilitating homeless communities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: My team's research found recent projects in the US that have discovered the tremendous role aesthetics and design play in helping to rehabilitate homeless communities.

sections.label: Incorporating space and aesthetics principles
sections.summary: The speaker says Government would do a disservice by not incorporating space and aesthetics principles in designing public rental housing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
sentences.text: Given the availability of such information and knowledge on how space and aesthetics can help improve human performance, we would be doing a disservice if the Government does not start incorporating such principles in the way we design public rental housing.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
sentences.text: The prevailing approach that provides only a basic and functional roof over people's heads needs to change.

sections.label: Partnering with philanthropic and private sectors
sections.summary: The speaker urges MND to partner with philanthropic and private sectors, arts groups, designers and volunteers to create uplifting designs in rental living spaces.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
sentences.text: There are philanthropists and now, many family offices we can tap on to do this with.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
sentences.text: I urge MND to partner with the philanthropic and private sectors, to get sponsorships and to work with arts groups, Design Singapore, local artists, designers, developers and volunteers to create uplifting designs and furnishings in rental living spaces.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan
sentences.text: MND launched this in March and I believe it is not too late to still harness this opportunity to pilot such partnerships for the transformation to redesign and rethink our rental housing approach.

sections.label: Integrated blocks and SRSF pilot
sections.summary: Another 17 integrated blocks will be completed in the next five years, and a Single Room Shared Facilities pilot for singles is being piloted.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Another 17 integrated blocks will be completed in the next five years and we will continue to build them, including in future Prime and Plus projects.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: For example, we announced earlier, as shared by Ms Tan, that we are piloting a new public rental typology for singles called the Single Room Shared Facilities (SRSF).

sections.label: 2-room rental flat allocation
sections.summary: Families with at least three members will be allocated a 2-room public rental flat, and HDB has started building 2-room rental flats with an additional partitioned space.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Families with at least three members will be allocated a 2-room public rental flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In recent years, HDB has also started building 2-room rental flats that come with an additional partitioned space.

sections.label: ComLink Rental Scheme launch
sections.summary: In November last year, HDB worked with MSF to launch the ComLink Rental Scheme to strengthen efforts and go further upstream.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: In November last year, we worked with MSF to launch the ComLink Rental Scheme to strengthen our efforts and go further upstream.

sections.label: Families engaged under scheme
sections.summary: To date, over 700 families have been engaged under this scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: To date, over 700 families have been engaged under this scheme.

sections.label: Scheme design and enhancements
sections.summary: The scheme's design couples Government and community support with family commitment, and it was enhanced to offer 3-room flats on shorter leases and raise the grant from $35,000 to $50,000.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The design of this scheme embodies the idea of social empowerment – coupling strong support from the Government and the community, with commitment and hard work from families.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: We enhanced the scheme recently to offer 3-room flats on shorter leases so that families have more housing options and increased the grant amount from $35,000 to $50,000.

sections.label: Households reached by team
sections.summary: The team has reached out to about 1,500 households over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: The team has reached out to about 1,500 households over the past three years.

sections.label: Home ownership support and grants
sections.summary: The Home ownership Support Team guided a family for over a year; they used $87,500 in housing grants and CPF to service their mortgage without cash outlay.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Home ownership Support Team worked closely with them for over a year, guiding them on their housing budget and options.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They were able to tap on housing grants totalling $87,500 and can service their mortgage entirely using their monthly CPF contributions, without any cash outlay.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We pay attention to the design of our homes and living environments and we go one step further, to pair hardware with software, and marshal resources from across Government and society to support families.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We welcome the people and private sectors to contribute your ideas and resources too and work with us to uplift families in public rental flats.
